description: Price table for cost accounting on the headless path. Ships UNSET on purpose.
_whyUnset: Every price here is null until somebody fills it in from the official pricing page, and scripts/llm.py reports 'cost not configured' rather than a number when they are. This is the same rule the rest of this system follows: a system whose stated purpose is preventing confident invention must not ship invented figures, and a price baked in at build time is wrong the first time it changes. A finance conversation started from a made-up number is worse than one started from 'we have not measured it yet'.
_howToFill: Read the current per-million-token input and output prices from the provider's pricing page, put them here, and commit the change with the date you read them. `currencyPerMillionTokens` is the unit for every value below.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.note: fast tier; the routing target for mechanical, high-volume skills

reporting.note: With prices unset the runner still reports TOKENS, which are measured rather than estimated and are the honest half of the answer. Multiply them yourself, or fill the table in.
